# proxmox_cluster_options (Resource)

Manages the cluster-wide options through `/cluster/options`. Only explicitly configured attributes are sent; clearing an attribute removes it from the Proxmox config. Destroy resets nothing.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_cluster_options" "current" {
  keyboard    = "en-us"
  max_workers = 4
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `console` (String) Default console viewer: `applet`, `vv`, `html5` or `xtermjs`.
- `description` (String) Cluster description shown in the GUI.
- `email_from` (String) Sender address for notification mails.
- `fencing` (String) Fencing mode: `watchdog`, `hardware` or `both`.
- `ha` (String) HA settings such as the shutdown policy.
- `http_proxy` (String) HTTP proxy for downloads and updates.
- `keyboard` (String) Default keyboard layout for guests.
- `language` (String) Default GUI language.
- `mac_prefix` (String) MAC address prefix for new guests.
- `max_workers` (Number) Maximum concurrent worker tasks.
- `migration` (String) Migration network and type, for example `secure` or `insecure`.
- `migration_unsecure` (Boolean) Allow unencrypted migrations.
- `next_id` (String) Lower bound for automatically assigned guest VMIDs.
- `tag_style` (String) Tag display style for the GUI.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `cluster`.
